memories.title: First English Sign I Read

memories.title: Home After Twenty Years

memories.title: The Old Master's Grave

memories.imagePrompt: contemplative color photograph of a man placing calligraphy brushes at a traditional Chinese gravestone, incense, soft light

memories.title: Dim Sum, One Empty Chair

memories.title: Bringing My Children Home

memories.title: Neither Fully Here Nor There

memories.imagePrompt: contemplative color photograph of an elderly Chinese man standing on a San Francisco bridge looking toward the bay, reflective, soft light

memories.title: Two Tongues, One Day

memories.title: The Jade My Mother Gave Me

memories.title: Behind the Counter

memories.title: Writing Letters for Elders

memories.title: The Shop Cat

memories.title: My Children Behind the Counter

memories.title: New Year Couplets

memories.title: A Name for a Newborn

memories.title: Commissioned Scrolls

memories.title: The Restaurant Sign

memories.title: The Community Centre Class

memories.title: My Granddaughter's First Stroke

memories.title: The Student Who Went Home

memories.title: Ink That Outlasts Us

bio: Born among the vines, married among them, still walking them each morning. Provence is my whole heart.
avatarPrompt: photorealistic portrait of an 84-year-old French Provençal woman with fine white hair, warm creased face, twinkling eyes, wearing a simple blouse and shawl; golden light, plain background, dignified

memories.title: The Harvest, Age Six
memories.description: Given a small basket to fill among the grown-ups. My hands purple, my heart bursting to be useful.
memories.imagePrompt: sepia 1940s photograph of a small girl carrying a basket among grape pickers in a Provence vineyard at harvest, period clothing, film grain

memories.title: The Old Stone Mas
memories.description: Thick walls cool in summer, a great hearth for winter. Five generations born under that tiled roof.
memories.imagePrompt: black-and-white 1940s photograph of a traditional Provençal stone farmhouse mas among vines, shutters and tiled roof, film grain

memories.title: Grandfather's Cellar
memories.description: The dark, the cool, the smell of oak and must. He let me taste from the barrel with a wooden spoon.
memories.imagePrompt: atmospheric sepia 1940s photograph of an old man and a girl in a dim wine cellar with oak barrels, lantern light, film grain

memories.title: Lavender at the Field's Edge
memories.description: Rows of purple humming with bees, the scent carried on the mistral. Provence taught me beauty before words.
memories.imagePrompt: faded vintage photograph of a child walking beside rows of blooming lavender in Provence, hills behind, nostalgic film tones

memories.title: The Mistral
memories.description: The wind that scours the sky blue and rattles the shutters for days. It shaped our tempers as it shaped the trees.
memories.imagePrompt: black-and-white 1940s photograph of wind-bent cypress trees and a shuttered Provençal farmhouse under a clear sky, film grain

memories.title: Hiding the Wine
memories.description: We bricked the best vintages into a false wall before the soldiers came. Some bottles we uncorked only at the Liberation.
memories.imagePrompt: black-and-white 1940s photograph of a family bricking wine bottles behind a false cellar wall by lantern light, tense, film grain

memories.title: Bread and Little Else
memories.description: Lean years of rationing and worry. My mother could make a soup from a stone and a prayer.
memories.imagePrompt: sepia 1940s photograph of a Provençal mother ladling thin soup for children at a wartime kitchen table, sparse, film grain

memories.title: The Day the War Ended
memories.description: Church bells across the whole valley, strangers embracing in the square. I was small but I felt the world exhale.
memories.imagePrompt: vintage black-and-white 1940s photograph of villagers celebrating Liberation in a Provence village square, joy and relief, film grain

memories.title: Rebuilding the Vines
memories.description: Neglected rows brought back to life row by row. My father said the vine forgives, if you return to it.
memories.imagePrompt: sepia late-1940s photograph of a family tending and pruning overgrown vineyard rows back to health, hopeful labour, film grain

memories.title: Market Day
memories.description: Wednesdays the square filled with cheese, olives, and news. Half the marriage matches were made over melons.
memories.imagePrompt: vintage sepia 1950s photograph of a bustling Provençal village market with produce stalls and shoppers, plane trees, film grain

memories.title: The Fountain
memories.description: Cold spring water where the women gathered to fill jugs and settle the world's affairs. My schoolroom of gossip.
memories.imagePrompt: black-and-white 1950s photograph of women filling jugs at a stone village fountain in Provence, chatting, film grain

memories.title: Pétanque Under the Planes
memories.description: The men clicked their boules in the dust every evening. The arguments outlasted the games by hours.
memories.imagePrompt: sepia 1950s photograph of old men playing pétanque under plane trees in a Provence village square, dust and shade, film grain

memories.title: Sunday Mass & Then the Feast
memories.description: Church, then the whole family to table until dusk. Faith and food, the twin pillars of the week.
memories.imagePrompt: warm sepia 1950s photograph of a Provençal family gathered at a long outdoor lunch table after Mass, wine and bread, film grain

memories.title: The Christmas Crèche
memories.description: Little painted santons on the mantel, one for every trade in the village. I still set out my mother's.
memories.imagePrompt: warm color close-up photograph of traditional Provencal painted santon clay figures arranged in a Christmas nativity scene, candlelight, soft focus

memories.title: Pruning in the Cold
memories.description: January among the bare vines, fingers numb, the secateurs clicking. The hardest work makes the sweetest wine.
memories.imagePrompt: black-and-white 1950s photograph of workers pruning bare winter vines in a frosty Provence vineyard, breath visible, film grain

memories.title: The Cherry Blossom
memories.description: Spring came all at once to the orchard, pink against blue. My mother said it was the earth forgiving winter.
memories.imagePrompt: faded vintage photograph of a Provencal cherry orchard in full spring blossom against a blue sky, nostalgic film tones

memories.title: Cutting the Lavender
memories.description: July, the sickles flashing, the air thick and purple with scent. We tied it in bundles for the whole year.
memories.imagePrompt: warm faded photograph of Provencal workers harvesting lavender with sickles in bloom-filled fields, hills behind, film tones

memories.title: The Vendange

memories.imagePrompt: vintage sepia 1950s photograph of a lively grape harvest in a Provence vineyard, workers with baskets, festive, film grain

memories.title: The Boy From the Next Farm

memories.imagePrompt: sepia 1950s photograph of a young couple walking a country lane at dusk in Provence after a village dance, tender, film grain

memories.title: Our Wedding, 1958

memories.imagePrompt: sepia 1950s wedding photograph of a French couple outside a Provençal village church, guests in period attire, film grain

memories.title: Working the Land Together

memories.imagePrompt: faded 1970s color photograph of a middle-aged couple working side by side pruning vines in a Provence vineyard, film tones

memories.title: The Last Harvest Together

memories.imagePrompt: poignant color photograph of an elderly couple cutting grapes together in autumn light, one last harvest, tender, warm tones

memories.title: Sixty Winters by the Fire
memories.description: Two chairs drawn to the hearth, his book, my mending, and no need to fill the silence. That was our happiness.
memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of an elderly couple sitting quietly by a stone farmhouse fireplace, two chairs, reading and mending, golden firelight

memories.title: Four Around the Table
memories.description: Four children raised on soup, wine cut with water, and the seasons. The kitchen was never quiet, thank God.
memories.imagePrompt: faded 1960s color photograph of a French farm family with four children at a rustic kitchen table, warm home interior, film tones

memories.title: Barefoot in the Vines
memories.description: The children grew up between the rows, as I had. Purple feet, scraped knees, and the freedom of the land.
memories.imagePrompt: nostalgic faded 1960s photograph of children playing barefoot among vineyard rows in Provence, sunny, film tones

memories.title: First Days of School
memories.description: Satchels too big, faces scrubbed, marched down the lane. I cried into my apron every single September.
memories.imagePrompt: sepia 1960s photograph of French village children with satchels walking to school down a country lane, period clothing, film grain

memories.title: The One Who Kept the Vines
memories.description: My youngest loved the land as I did and stayed to work it. The domaine did not die with us. What relief.
memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of an aging mother and her grown son walking the vineyard rows together, generational, golden light

memories.title: Sixty Years Married
memories.description: The whole family under the plane tree, four generations, one long table. Henri raised his glass and could not speak.
memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of a large French family celebrating a diamond wedding anniversary at a long table under a plane tree, joyful, golden light

memories.title: Teaching the Little Ones to Pick

memories.imagePrompt: joyful color photograph of an elderly woman and grandchildren picking grapes in a Provence vineyard, small baskets, sunny autumn

memories.title: Sunday Lunch, Still

memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of a large multigenerational French family at a lively Sunday lunch in a rustic farmhouse kitchen, daylight

memories.title: Without Henri Now
memories.description: His chair at the head, empty two years. I set his place at Christmas still, and pour a small glass for the table.

memories.title: The Copper Pots
memories.description: My mother's pots, blackened and beloved, hanging by the hearth. I have cooked in them for sixty years.
memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of well-used copper pots hanging by a stone farmhouse hearth in Provence, rustic, soft light

memories.title: Daube on a Winter Night

memories.title: The Herb Garden Door

memories.title: Grandmother's Recipe Notebook

memories.title: Pissaladière Fridays

memories.title: The Christmas Thirteen Desserts
memories.description: The old Provençal tradition, thirteen sweets on the table. I lay them out exactly as my grandmother did.
memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of the traditional Provençal thirteen desserts of Christmas laid on a table with candles, festive, soft light

memories.title: Teaching My Granddaughter

memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of an elderly woman teaching a young granddaughter to roll pastry in a rustic kitchen, cheerful, daylight

memories.title: The Harvesters' Lunch

memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of a long outdoor table set for vineyard harvest workers under a tree in Provence, rustic food and wine, sunny

memories.title: A Table Always Set for One More

memories.imagePrompt: warm color photograph of a welcoming rustic Provençal kitchen table set with bread, soup and wine, an extra place laid, soft light

memories.title: The Village Fête

memories.imagePrompt: vibrant color photograph of a large communal Provençal village feast with aioli and long tables in a square, festive, sunny

memories.title: Still Cooking at Eighty-Four

memories.title: Tarte Tatin, Upside Down
